assignment.title: History essay
assignment.descriptionText: Choose a local historical event. Write a 900-word essay using two course readings. Revise and submit a PDF.

steps.text: Choose a local historical event and review the essay instructions.
Read the two specified course readings thoroughly and take notes on how they relate to the event.
Create an essay outline with thesis, main arguments, supporting evidence, and a conclusion.
Write the first draft of the 900-word essay, incorporating the two course readings.
Revise the draft, focusing on clarity, argument flow, and use of the course readings.
Format the essay, convert to PDF, and double-check it against the supplied instructions.
